name: global_component_count
formula: number of 8-connected components in B_g (3x3 all-ones structuring element)

name: refined_component_count
formula: number of 8-connected components in B_r (3x3 all-ones structuring element)

name: global_boundary_fraction
formula: boundary_fraction(B_g); E = binary_erosion(B, 3x3 ones, border_value=0); boundary = B AND NOT E; boundary_fraction = sum(boundary)/(256*256)

name: refined_boundary_fraction
formula: boundary_fraction(B_r); E = binary_erosion(B, 3x3 ones, border_value=0); boundary = B AND NOT E; boundary_fraction = sum(boundary)/(256*256)

name: predicted_roi_area_fraction
formula: frozen Phase25B corrected in-canvas ROI area / 512^2, area = max(0,min(512,x2)-max(0,x1)) * max(0,min(512,y2)-max(0,y1))
